description.en: Glassmorphism skin for dsh: layered frost on the conversation, sidebar, composer and overlays, with three rendering tiers, adjustable intensity and background tone, glass message bubbles, and live support for reduced-motion, reduced-transparency, increased-contrast and forced-colors. Client-only; the host-side apply() registers no tools and makes no network requests.
description.zh: 玻璃外观皮肤：对话、侧栏、输入区与浮层分层磨砂，三档渲染质量、可调强度与背景色调、消息玻璃，跟随减少动效/减少透明/增加对比/强制颜色四种系统偏好。纯客户端，宿主侧 apply() 不注册工具、不发网络请求。
